family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Linear/Hatch/Angle/Louvre - Rectangle - Capped

problem_keywords: Client wants a linear timber-batten or timber-louvre ceiling aesthetic, but is constrained to a standard 1200x600 suspended grid infrastructure.
Need the appearance of architectural slatted baffles in an existing 1200x600 ceiling grid while allowing upward lighting or HVAC air return into the ceiling void.
not_for: not_for): Do not use if maximum sound absorption is specified (Hatch uncapped achieves NRC 0.60
not_for): Must verify directional orientation during install (tiles can be laid parallel for continuous linear runs or alternating for a parquet effect).
use_cases: Louvre uncapped provides directional screening—it blocks the view into the plenum from normal walking angles while remaining completely open vertically for ventilation.
Recommend Linear or Louvre styles in solid colors or Acoustic Timber printed finishes. The solid capping panel ensures high acoustic absorption while blocking visual sightlines to overhead services.
